body.purpose: Intro and prose, capped at ~40rem measure.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase eyebrow and input labels.

mono.purpose: All user data: JSON, jq paths, chips, tree rows.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Resting lift for buttons and fields.

shadows.name: ambient-high
shadows.purpose: The heaviest lift, most raised surfaces.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border, shadow, color, and transform state changes, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action; copies the derived jq expression.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #5b53e0; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 18 30 / 0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4a42cf; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Copied Button
components.description: The 2-second success confirmation state of the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-copied { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #1a7f47; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Filter Input
components.description: Monospace field for a jq expression that highlights matching nodes.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #c3c8d6; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #3d2f6b; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 18 30 / 0.06); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #5b53e0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #5b53e0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #5b53e0 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A selection token for one clicked value, with a remove control.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #4a42cf; background: #eeecfc; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5b53e0 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-remove { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-remove:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5b53e0 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Breadcrumb Item
components.description: An ancestor button that widens the current selection.
components.css: .ds-crumb { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; color: #5a6173; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c3c8d6; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-crumb:hover:not(.ds-crumb-active) { color: #5b53e0; border-color: #5b53e0; background: #eeecfc; } .ds-crumb-active { color: #4a42cf; background: #eeecfc; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #5b53e0 45%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Tree Row
components.description: One row of the virtualized value tree; highlighted state marks selection/match.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 28px; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tree-row:hover { background: #f6f7fb; } .ds-tree-row-highlighted { background: #eeecfc; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #5b53e0; } .ds-tree-toggle { width: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #5a6173; } .ds-tree-label { font-weight: 600; color: #1a1d29; } .ds-tree-value { color: #5a6173; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

narrative.overview: jq-pointer looks like a precision tool, not a landing page. Everything lives in a single narrow reading column on a cool blue-grey field, with a soft radial glow behind the header. Surfaces are flat and calm at rest; the interface earns attention only where the user is working. The palette is a restrained cool-neutral system tinted toward a single indigo accent, the tool's one voice. Monospace carries every piece of user data; Inter carries the surrounding chrome. The system flips wholesale under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
keyCharacteristics: Single narrow column, flat surfaces, generous vertical rhythm.
One indigo accent, used sparingly for state and action only.
Monospace for all data, Inter for all chrome.
Depth from small ambient shadows, never from borders-plus-glow.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The indigo accent is the only chromatic voice. It appears on selection, focus, links, and the single primary action, kept to a small fraction of any screen. Danger and success are signals, not decoration.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every value that comes from or goes to the user's document is set in the monospace stack. Chrome is never monospace; data is never proportional.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation is small and ambient, never a decorative drop shadow, and never a 1px border paired with a wide soft glow.

dos: Do keep the indigo accent (#5b53e0) to selection, focus, links, and the single primary action; treat its rarity as the point.
Do set every piece of user data (JSON, jq paths, chips, breadcrumbs, tree rows) in the monospace stack, and all chrome in Inter.
Do lift surfaces with the small ambient shadow steps (Ambient Low/Mid/High); keep surfaces flat at rest.
Do keep to the single 46rem column and the existing spacing scale (0.25rem to 3rem) for vertical rhythm.
Do write plain, located status text and gate all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do maintain full light/dark parity: any new token must define both scheme values.
donts: Don't add hero metrics, identical feature-card grids, or a tracked-uppercase eyebrow above every section; this is a tool, not a marketing landing page.
Don't use gradient text or background-clip: text for emphasis; emphasis is weight and size.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide soft drop shadow on the same element, and don't over-round: cards top out at 14px, pills are for chips only.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right greater than 1px as an accent stripe; the tree's selection bar is a 2px inset box-shadow, not a border.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use danger/success colours for anything but real error and confirmation states.
Don't set user data in a proportional font or chrome in monospace.
